sources: https://www.sterling-kansas.com/253/Parks-and-Recreation (City of Sterling, 'Sterling Lake Campground & RV Park'), read 2026-11-05: 'Located on East Van Buren Street next to beautiful Sterling Lake, our Recreational Vehicle ( RV ) Park consists of 14 parking places, all with full hook-up services of water, electric and sewer. Pin is at the strip's west end, within ~70 m of its centre.
Overpass (maps.mail.ru mirror) 2026-11-05: way 479184875 natural=water, water=pond, 9.86 acres centred 38.20383,-98.20286 (the city calls it Sterling Lake; above the ~5-acre pond line)

summary: City page confirms 14 full-hookup 50A sites, $25/night year round (tents $5), dump, showers, FCFS only, 14-day max; season year_round added from the rate line. Not waterfront confirmed (pads 60-90 m from a 9.9-acre lake across the park road and trees). Phone missing: city gives 620-278-3423.
flags: PHONE MISSING (apply.py does not write phone): the city page says 'For more information, please call (620) 278-3423 or (620) 278-3411 during business hours'; 620-278-3423 is City Hall (114 North Broadway). Suggest phone 620-278-3423.

WATERFRONT (confirms stored not waterfront): imagery shows the RV pads as a gravel strip along the railroad on the park's north edge, ~60-90 m from the lake's north shore across the paved park road, a sand volleyball court and a treeline - no open apron and no clear sightline. Lake is 9.86 acres (OSM tags it pond; above the 5-acre line, the city calls it Sterling Lake). No upgrade lead.
Pads sit right beside a railroad line (imagery; whether it is busy was not checked) - stated in the proposed note.
